verdict: Paid campaigns are dark; organic reach has also stopped this week.
narrative: This period, both Meta and Google Ads show zero spend, zero clicks, and zero leads — the paid campaigns appear fully paused. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile drove 30 actions earlier in the 28-day window, but activity dropped to zero over the last 14 days, a hard stop rather than a gradual slowdown. Website traffic also pulled back, with sessions averaging 4 per day over the last three days versus 6 per day the three days prior. We are actively investigating the GBP stoppage and the status of the paid campaigns to confirm what is paused and why. Expect an update on both fronts before next week's report.
